summary: This change renames formatPrice to formatMoney in src/money.ts and adds a currency parameter formatted through Intl.NumberFormat. It also updates invoiceLines to pass a currency that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice still imported by cart
findings.problem: This change renames formatPrice to formatMoney without updating src/cart.ts. The file src/cart.ts still imports formatPrice on line 1 and calls it on line 8.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript compiler rejects src/cart.ts because money.ts no longer exports formatPrice. The build fails, and cartTotal cannot run.
findings.fix: Update cartTotal in src/cart.ts to import formatMoney and call it with a currency. Alternatively, keep exporting formatPrice as a wrapper around formatMoney.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: The new formatMoney adds thousands separators and moves the minus sign before the currency symbol. No test in the repository exercises formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: Nothing catches regressions in invoice text that customers see. Nothing catches currency-specific output either.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines covering USD, another currency, large amounts and negative amounts.
